description: This is a shell script file that contains tests for the behavior of a notes fanout mechanism in a Git repository. It defines functions to check file paths with specific fanout structures, tests to create notes, verify their structure, delete notes, and verify fanout restructuring.

methods.name: path_has_fanout
methods.description: Checks if a given path matches the fanout directory structure based on a specified fanout size.

methods.name: touched_one_note_with_fanout
methods.description: Checks whether a particular note commit has a specified fanout structure after a modification (add or delete).

methods.name: all_notes_have_fanout
methods.description: Verifies that all notes in a given commit follow a specific fanout structure.
